posts.name: Plasterboard
posts.cooked:
Many weeks ago I pre-ordered WotC and the mini expansions (guise, wagemaster, omni 4) from my local game store. Later on I inquired about a rough availability date and they said approximately 12/30. On another visit they implied that they already had the WotC but could not make them available. Now on the 29th I get a call saying WotC will be available on 12/30 as predicted (yay!). I arrive at my local gaming store and they have the WotC box, but absolutely none of the mini expansions.

If the embargo on all WotC materials was due to a union strike that delayed the mini expansion and the main box was released without those mini expansions, why was there an embargo in the first place?

posts.name: cmschex
posts.cooked: I'm pretty sure it was because they were trying their best to be able to start shipping to pre-order customers before having it release in the normal retail channels.

posts.name: Killswitch
posts.cooked:
I may be incorrect (if so, go ahead and correct me), but I believe there were two shipments. One was shipped to headquarters early so Christopher could demo the new decks at conventions and other sorts of appearances, and so the stores could sell them around the same time as we, the ones who pre-ordered our copies, could receive ours. The mini-expansions are extra goodies apart from the main set, so I can see why they only chose to ship as many WotC boxes as they could to make it cost efficient. Unfortunately, it didn't work out that way, and they're sitting on a stash of copies and want to eventually sell them since they have waiting customers.

I'm okay with them finally going ahead and selling them. They've probably had them for weeks, and we'll probably wait longer. However, we also get shiny new promos, mini-expansions and art prints, and they don't. I'd say it's fair.
